purpose: One bounded repair attempt of the rejected tensor design, not a novel-method claim
rule: Multiply each two-word encoded input and gate output by a public input/state-dependent odd scalar; decode final row modulo 2
hypothesis: Large concrete support alone might defeat earlier two-state propagation; test static modulo-2 quotient before further implementation
attacker: Public IR and scaling rule only; no internal bases, gate types, private files, test outputs or sampled traces
primary: Complete equivalent Boolean DAG reconstruction after modulo-2 projection
reuse: All six public tensor DAGs and their saved input sets; unchanged existing recover.py used on projected IR
controls: same-parity input columns must not be reported recovered
decision: Reject repair if equivalent Boolean circuit is recovered; no Wasm/SHA expansion or additional scale-function tuning
